newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end slightly lower amid mixed selling.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end slightly lower amid mixed selling.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed barely weaker after prices succumbed to trade selling just ahead of the close, market sources said.
Trade and speculative buying carried the benchmark September contract over resistance at 75.00 cents and to the day's high of 75.70 cents in early dealings.
Light trade selling knocked September off the high and pressured the contract below unchanged on the close. Analysts expect the market to remain in a downtrend.
"The fundamentals continue to weigh on the market and I don't know if that will change," Celeste Georgakis, vice president with Dean Witter, said.
Most-active September orange juice ended 0.10 cent weaker at 73.85 cents a lb, traded 75.70 to 73.65 cents. The rest of the board closed 0.35 lower to 0.35 cent firmer.
Support was pegged at 73.50 cents in September.
An estimated 2,500 lots changed hands on the day compared wiht Tuesday's official 1,214 lots.
